notes.title: Demo Version Update Notice
notes.content:
Thank you for trying out the demo version and for completing the questionnaire!

We've updated the demo version with the following improvements:



- Redesigned key assignment for changing expressions in the status menu

- Added cursor movement settings for AZERTY keyboards

- Adjusted the volume levels of certain sound effects and voice lines



We’ll continue enhancing the experience for future releases—stay tuned for more updates!
